info.title: API.SH: Imgur
info.description: The Imgur API from API.SH: public Imgur data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
An Imgur album (or gallery post) with every image and video in it: id, link, type, width, height, size, views, animated and sound flags, title, description, upload time and mp4 link; plus the album title, description, upload time, views, privacy, layout, cover and author. Albums marked mature are not returned.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/imgur-album

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every comment on an Imgur post, with nested replies: id, text, author, points, upvotes, downvotes, time, parent and platform. `total_with_replies` counts replies too.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/imgur-comments

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The first 60 posts of an Imgur gallery list: most viral or newest (sorted by virality or time), or top posts of a day, week, month, year or all time. Each post has its id, link, title, thumbnail, points, views, type and tags. Pass `page` to go past the first 60 posts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/imgur-gallery

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: hot (most viral, default), new (user submitted) or top.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: For hot and new: viral (default) or time.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: For top: day (default), week, month, year or all.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of the gallery list (1-based). Given, the list comes page by page past the first 60 posts (each page holds up to about 200 posts) and every post also has its date, up and down votes, comment and favourite counts, image count and author; `next_page` is the next page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One public Imgur post: title, description, date, views, upvotes, downvotes, points, score, virality, comment and favourite counts, tags, author, and every image or video in it (URL, type, size, dimensions, duration, sound). Posts marked mature answer 403. Pass `include=comments` for the comment threads.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/imgur-post

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Imgur post id or a gallery/album URL (`url` is accepted too).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `comments`: also return the post's comments in `comment_list` (text, author, points, up and down votes, date, and the replies nested under each, up to 200 top-level comments). Costs one more upstream request.

parameters.name: comments_sort
parameters.description: Order of `comment_list`: best (default), top or new.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Imgur's public gallery by words: id, title, link, views, upvotes, downvotes, points, comments, favorites, author, tags and image count of each post. Sort by virality, top or newest, with a time window for top; paged, `next_page` is null when there are no more. Posts marked mature are left out.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/imgur-search

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Time window: all (default), day, week, month or year.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Posts in an Imgur tag, most viral, top of a period or newest: id, title, link, views, upvotes, downvotes, points, comments, favorites, author, tags and the images of each post, plus the tag's followers and total posts. 60 posts a page; `next_page` is null when there are no more. Posts marked mature are left out.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/imgur-tag

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: For sort=top: day, week (default), month, year or all.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
